fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Essential Interactive Series Seated Elliptical - SF-E322004
fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Rise up to the intensity of your workouts or sit back as you cruise through your strides with the Sunny Health & Fitness Essential Interactive Series Seated Elliptical Trainer - SF-E322004. Focus on training solo or connect your elliptical to the SunnyFit® App to view your performance in real time and follow along to free training videos created by our Sunny fitness trainers. This elliptical bike combo exercise machine features a heavy duty 11 LB flywheel for a smoother and more efficient workout. Whether you’re cross training or engaging in HIIT workouts, the Interactive Series Seated Elliptical Trainer – SF-E322004 is designed to help you reach your fitness goals the way you want.
• SMART FITNESS: Stride along with Sunny Health & Fitness expert trainers on the Sunny Health & Fitness SunnyFit® App. Optionally connect your preferred mobile device through Bluetooth and view your performance metrics in real time (Smart version only).
• SunnyFit® App: The all new SunnyFit® App takes your Sunny workouts to the next level! View your live metrics displayed in real time as you tour the world with real location maps. Get the results you want with customized workout plans. Explore 100+ workout videos that fits your schedule and goals. Compare your results on the elliptical leaderboard, share your fitness experiences, get workout tips and much more!
• DIGITAL MONITOR: Measure and track your workouts more effectively with the onboard digital monitor which displays: Calories, Distance, Odometer, Pulse, RPM, Speed, Time and a Scan mode.
• ADJUSTABLE SEAT: The comfortable, supportive, and adjustable seat is a welcome addition during those long elliptical sessions. It is 4-way adjustable and measures 10.6L x 9.4W x 2.8H in.
• DEVICE HOLDER: Place your tablet, phone, or other mobile devices to stay connected. Follow along online with our Sunny Health & Fitness trainers for certified fitness tips, advice, and lessons.
• HEAVY FLYWHEEL: Solid and sturdy, the 11 LB flywheel enhances your elliptical cross training workouts by delivering stability, smoothness and maintaining momentum. 
• MAGNETIC RESISTANCE: Choose between 8 levels of magnetic resistance using the tension knob to provide multi-variable levels of resistance to your workout or fitness lessons.
• PULSE SENSORS: Check your pulse rate safely at any moment during your workout with the handle mounted pulse sensors.
• TRANSPORATION WHEELS: This indoor elliptical is not bound to one room after setup. Use the front-loaded transportation wheels to move this machine across several home surfaces.

The advanced digital monitor allows you to personalize your training by setting goals for time, distance, calories, and heart rate, with real-time tracking for better results. Built from durable materials, this heavy-duty machine supports up to 300LB, providing long-lasting use for the entire family. For added convenience, it includes a device holder, bottle holder, transportation wheels, and floor stabilizers for safe use on any surface. fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
The SunnyFit® App compatible elliptical trainer is the perfect addition to any home gym. With 16 levels of quiet and smooth electromagnetic resistance, this elliptical is built with a large 18-inch stride length and full motion arm exercisers to focus on full body workouts. This durable and sturdy elliptical machine promotes low-impact cardio that works your abs, legs, hips, and glutes but is still gentle on your joints. Featuring 12 pre-programmed workouts and 4 user programs, your elliptical includes multiple exercise options for a wide variety of workouts with each use.
• CONNECTED FITNESS: With convenient Bluetooth connectivity, the Smart Elliptical Machine connects to the SunnyFit® App and allows you to access an array of free elliptical workouts and other fitness programs. Track your progress, set fitness goals, access personalized workout plans, and compete with other community members to get to the top of the leaderboard. Have all the workouts of your choice right at your fingertips, while also feeling supported as a member of this like-minded SunnyFit® App community.
• ELECTROMAGNETIC RESISTANCE: With 16 different levels of electromagnetic resistance that can be controlled from your machine or through the SunnyFit® App, you will be able to set your workout intensity level to perfectly meet your needs. Crank up the resistance for a challenging full-body workout or dial it down for a low-impact and low-intensity recovery session.
• 12 PRE-PROGRAMMED WORKOUTS + 4 USER PROGRAMS: Take the guesswork out of your exercise session and use one of the 12 pre-programmed elliptical workouts built into the machine. If you prefer to customize your own workout, the Smart Elliptical Machine allows you to create up to 4 unique user programs for a personalized workout experience.
• LONG STRIDE LENGTH: Increase full-body muscle activation and feel the full range of your stride on your Smart Elliptical. With an 18-inch stride length, the elliptical is ideal for users of all sizes and fitness levels.
• LOW-IMPACT CARDIO: Protect your joints while still challenging yourself and working your full body. Target your glutes, hamstrings, quads, chest, back, biceps, triceps, and core each time you use your Smart Elliptical. Improve cardiovascular health and build strength but also enjoy a workout that is gentle on your body.
• STURDY AND DURABLE: With a premium quality, heavy-duty frame your elliptical provides a sturdy design that keeps you safe while you exercise. Featuring 6 floor stabilizers, your elliptical will stay in place through even the toughest of workouts. Use the transportation wheels to move your elliptical to your desired workout location, or to place out of the way when not in use.
• COMFORTABLE RIDE: Exercise in comfort with the non-slip, full-motion arm exercisers. The large, non-slip pedals secure your feet in place for maximum stability during your workout.
• CONVENIENCE: Have everything you need for your workout right at your fingertips. Use the device holder to secure your phone or tablet to workout with the SunnyFit® App or stream your favorite movies and TV shows. Hydrate during your workout without missing a beat, as the centrally located bottle holder keeps your water bottle just an arm’s reach away.

This machine is also equipped with Bluetooth connectivity, providing access to a vast range of training videos and virtual world tours. Its compact and foldable design makes it ideal for space-saving storage. An LCD digital monitor allows for tracking workout metrics, and a device holder adds convenience for entertainment or fitness apps. Non-slip pedals ensure safety and stability during use. Its unique air walking motion combines the ease of walking, the glide of skiing, and the endurance of cross-country skiing with the calorie burn of running, minus the impact, caters to a variety of workout intensities. This machine is also equipped with Bluetooth connectivity, providing access to a vast range of training videos and virtual world tours, including simulated cross-country skiing experiences. Its compact and foldable design makes it ideal for space-saving storage. An LCD digital monitor allows for tracking workout metrics, and a device holder adds convenience for entertainment or fitness apps. Non-slip pedals ensure safety and stability during use. The Air Walk Trainer is easy to assemble and backed by Sunny Health & Fitness's commitment to quality, including a 1-year structural frame warranty.
• 【LOW-IMPACT, FULL-BODY CARDIO EXERCISE】Experience a gentle yet effective workout that minimizes stress on your joints. The Air Walk Trainer offers a full-body cardio session, engaging arms, legs, & core, perfect for all fitness levels and ages. 
• 【SIMULATED WALKING AND SKIING MOTION】The Air Glider replicates the natural motion of walking in the air. This unique 'air walking' motion provides a smooth, flowing exercise that combines the rhythm of walking, the glide of skiing, and the endurance of cross-country skiing with the intensity of running.
• 【ADJUSTABLE ABDOMINAL SUPPORTER】Equipped with a cushion abdominal supporter and adjustable height, this elliptical air walker ensures superior stability and comfort during your workouts. Maintain better balance and train with confidence!
• 【FREE CONNECTED APP】 Enjoy FREE access to the SunnyFit App with every Sunny Health & Fitness product—no membership fees! Dive into 1,000+ trainer-led workouts, explore 10,000+ virtual scenic tours, track your progress, challenge others, and much more!
• 【COMPACT & FOLDABLE DESIGN】Maximize your space and maintain a clutter-free environment with the Air Walk Trainer's sleek, foldable design. This machine is engineered for easy storage, folding down to a compact form that can be tucked away.
• 【LCD DIGITAL MONITOR】Track your progress with features including Scan, Time, Count, Calories Burned, and Total Count. This user-friendly interface is designed to help you optimize your exercise routine and achieve your fitness goals.
• 【MICRO-ADJUSTABLE FLOOR STABILIZER】Easily adapt to uneven surface! Simply twist the stabilizer end cap to micro-adjust the height, ensuring a steady and secure workout experience even on uneven floors.
• 【SAFE AND SECURE NON-SLIP PEDALS】Step confidently with the Air Walk Trainer's non-slip pedals designed for stability. These pedals provide a secure footing, reducing the risk of slips and enabling you to focus on your workout with peace of mind.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Smart Motorized Mini Elliptical With 18-Levels Speed - SF-E324028
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
The motorized mini elliptical features 18 adjustable speed levels and a remote control for easy operation, offering a convenient, low-impact workout. Perfect for rehabilitation, recovery, and daily cardio routines, it provides a safe exercise experience that minimizes strain on your joints, including the knees, hips, ankles, and back. The elliptical promotes enhanced stability and safety with a square steel base, floor stabilizers, adjustable foot straps, and an auto-stop function that activates if any issues are detected. Enjoy fast adjustment with the remote control, allowing you to effortlessly change your pace, while the bi-directional movement targets various muscle groups for a full-body workout. Its compact and lightweight design and built-in carry handle make it easy to store and transport with maximum convenience.
• 【MOTORIZED MINI ELLIPTICAL + REMOTE CONTROL】Features 18 speed levels and a remote control for effortless operation, making it ideal for rehabilitation, recovery, and cardio routines with low-impact, joint-friendly exercise.
• 【POWER ON w/6 PRE-PROGRAMS & POWER OFF MODE】Includes 6 pre-programmed settings for diverse workouts, and operates even in power-off mode, offering added convenience and safety—perfect for seniors or those with leg mobility challenges.
• 【LOW-IMPACT EXERCISE FOR JOINT HEALTH】Designed to minimize strain on your joints, providing a safe and effective workout that benefits the knees, hips, ankles, and back, making it ideal for seniors or those recovering from injury.
• 【FREE FITNESS APP CONNECTION】Enjoy FREE access to the SunnyFit APP with NO membership fees! Dive into 1,000+ trainer-led workouts, explore 10,000+ virtual scenic tours, track your progress, challenge others, and much more!
• 【FULLY ASSEMBLED】Ready to use straight out of the box, saving you time and effort. No assembly required—just set it up and start enjoying a smooth, hassle-free workout experience.
• 【ENHANCED STABILITY AND SAFETY】 Features a square steel base, floor stabilizers, adjustable foot straps, and an auto-stop function that activates if any issues are detected, ensuring a safe and stable workout.
• 【FAST ADJUSTMENT & BI-DIRECTIONAL MOVEMENT】No bending down to adjust—easily control your pace by remote controller, while bi-directional movement targets different muscle groups for a complete workout.
• 【ENHANCED METRICS WITH HR200】Upgrade your workouts with the Sunny HR200 heart rate monitor (sold separately). Track your pulse in real time with color-coded indicators: red for exceeding your range, green for efficiency, and yellow for intensity.
• 【COMPACT & LIGHTWEIGHT DESIGN】 Weighing just 18.1LB and with dimensions of 19.5 x 18.1 x 10.4", this mini elliptical is easy to store and transport, featuring a built-in carry handle for added convenience.
• 【20+ YEARS OF EXCELLENCE】Sunny Health & Fitness, a U.S.-based company, offers top-quality equipment with a commitment to excellence. Certified U.S. customer service team and trainers ensure a truly unmatched FIT FOR EVERYONE experience.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Elite Interactive Series Exercise Recumbent Cross Trainer and Elliptical – SF-RBE420049
fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
CONNECTED FITNESS: With Bluetooth connectivity, the SunnyFit app allows you to access an array of free workouts and hundreds of fitness programs. Track your progress, set fitness goals, access personalized workout plans, and compete with other community members to get to the top of the leader board. Have all the workouts of your choice right at your fingertips, while also feeling supported as a member of this likeminded community.
• DESIGNED FOR LOW IMPACT: Protect your joints while still challenging yourself. Our recumbent elliptical allows you to improve cardiovascular health and build strength but is also gentle on your joints. If you are in need of a recovery day, simply decrease your resistance and use the Elite Interactive Series as a low-impact active recovery tool.
• FULL BODY WORKOUT: Workout your upper and lower body simultaneously, engaging all major muscle groups to build strength and burn more calories. Modify the workout by isolating your legs or arms for added intensity. Please note: arms move when you stop pedaling.
• EASY ON AND OFF: The easy on-off design provides a simple, hassle-free transition from start to finish. With minimal obstruction between the handlebars and the seat, you can step through your machine and sit down safely before starting your workout.
• 12-LEVEL MAGNETIC RESISTANCE: Switch up the intensity of your workout with the convenient tension knob. With a simple twist, you can increase or decrease magnetic resistance so your workout can remain challenging and effective throughout your fitness journey.
• COMFORTABLE RIDE: Enjoy the padded seat and contoured mesh back support for a more comfortable and pleasant workout. With the easy seat adjuster, you no longer need to get off the machine to adjust the seat to your height. Simply engage the handle by your side and adjust to your comfort level.
• DIGITAL MONITOR: Tracking your progress is simple with the digital monitor screen. Keep yourself motivated and on pace by viewing your Time, Speed, Distance, Calories, Heart Rate, and Odometer throughout each workout.
• DEVICE HOLDER: Control your indoor workout entertainment directly in front of you. The built-in device holder enables you to stream and watch your favorite movies or TV series directly from your tablet or mobile device.
• NON-SLIP FOOT PEDALS: Wide textured foot pedals will ensure safe footing during the most demanding and vigorous workouts.
• SUNNY STATE OF MIND: In our 20 years of serving the fitness community, we have impacted the lives of over 10 million customers. We are confident that our products are not only built to last but will also enable you to achieve your indoor cardio goals. Our vision and core mission are to stand beside you throughout your entire process. We enable you to enjoy your workouts with our products and our SunnyFit app that comes with over 500+ workouts taught by our certified Sunny Trainers.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Performance Interactive Series Recumbent Elliptical SF-RBE420035
fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Enjoy a low-impact and efficient workout with the Performance Interactive Series Recumbent Elliptical. Use the 8 levels of smooth magnetic resistance to deliver a full-body workout while still being gentle on your joints. Feel comfortable throughout the duration of your workout with the large, cushioned, easily adjustable seat. For an enhanced workout experience, connect your recumbent elliptical to the SunnyFit® App to follow along with professional trainer-led fitness courses and exercise with other members of the SunnyFit® App community.
• CONNECTED FITNESS: With Bluetooth connectivity, this recumbent elliptical bike connects to the SunnyFit app and allows you to access 1000+ free workouts and fitness programs. Track your progress, set fitness goals, access personalized workout plans, and compete with other community members to get to the top of the leaderboard. Have all the workouts of your choice right at your fingertips, while also feeling supported as a member of this like-minded SunnyFit community.
• DESIGNED FOR LOW IMPACT: Protect your joints while still challenging yourself. Our recumbent elliptical allows you to improve cardiovascular health and build strength but is also gentle on your body.
• FULL BODY WORKOUT: Work various muscle groups in both your upper and lower body by simultaneously using the moveable handles and elliptical-sized foot pedals. If you want a more focused workout, use the handles or foot pedals independently for a targeted upper or lower body burn.
• EASY ON AND OFF: The easy on-off design provides a simple, hassle-free transition from start to finish. With minimal obstruction between the handlebars and the seat, you can step through your machine and sit down safely before starting your workout.
• MAGNETIC RESISTANCE: 8 Levels of smooth and adjustable magnetic resistance makes it easy to modify intensity to deliver the perfect workout challenge.
• COMFORTABLE RIDE: The large, cushioned, and easily adjustable seat provides comfort throughout each workout. Enjoy the non-slip handlebar and textured foot plates to keep your grip and feet firmly in place, so you don’t have to deal with constantly re-adjusting.
• PERFORMANCE MONITOR: Track various fitness metrics during each workout. View your time, speed, RPM, distance, Watts, calories, and resistance on the digital performance monitor. Use the convenient pulse sensors on the seat’s stationary handlebars to instantly view your pulse and exercise within your target heart rate range. Train at your perfect intensity level every workout!
• DEVICE HOLDER: Secure your phone or tablet in the centrally located device holder. Stay entertained during your workouts and stream your favorite TV show, or dial in your exercise session with a trainer-led workout in the SunnyFit app.
• STURDY YET EASILY TRANSPORTABLE: Use your machine’s floor stabilizers to keep your recumbent elliptical bike securely in place, even through your most intense workouts. Move your machine to your desired location with the easy-to-use transportation wheels, so you can store it out of the way when not in use.
• SUNNY STATE OF MIND: In our 20 years of serving the fitness community, we have impacted the lives of over 10 million customers, and we are confident that our equipment is not only built to last but will also enable you to achieve your cardio goals. Our vision and core mission is to stand beside you throughout your entire process. We enable you to enjoy your workouts with our products and our SunnyFit app which comes with over 1000+ workouts taught by our professionally certified Sunny Trainers.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness SunnyFit Heart Rate Monitor - HR200
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Experience precision pulse tracking with the Sunny Health & Fitness armband heart rate monitor, featuring cutting-edge optical sensor technology, delivering stunning accuracy in heart rate monitoring. Stay informed in real time through a vivid four-color digital indicator, guiding you through your personalized heart rate zone. Effortlessly sync with your smartphone via Bluetooth using our SunnyFit app while ensuring compatibility with bike computers and sports watches through ANT+ connectivity. Gain exclusive access to fitness insights and tracking within the SunnyFit app, conveniently monitoring your pulse in real time, customizing heart rate goals, and tracking steps all in one intuitive platform. Seamlessly integrate your workout data with popular fitness apps like Peloton, Strava, Zwift, and more for a comprehensive fitness experience. Receive instant vibration and visual alerts if your heart rate surpasses your target range, keeping you informed during workouts. Our performance-oriented armband guarantees a comfortable and secure fit, catering to intense workouts, allowing you to focus on your fitness goals. Easy charging with the magnetic clip charger ensures your heart rate monitor is always ready, with battery status conveniently visible on the SunnyFit app or through alternating red and green lights on the device when it’s time to charge.
• PRECISION PULSE TRACKING - Experience precision with our latest optical sensor technology. Monitor your heart rate accurately with a vivid four-color digital display guiding you through your personalized zones.
• CUSTOMIZED HEART RATE ZONE & REAL-TIME ALERTS - Set your own heart rate zone & receive instant haptic feedback with vibration. Red indicator if your heart rate surpasses your target range, stay in the green for efficiency & yellow for intensity.
• CONNECTED FITNESS EXPERIENCE - Connect to SunnyFit app and sync to your smartphone via Bluetooth. Track your heart rate and your steps. Set personalized maximum bpm goals all in a seamless easy-to-use app. The HR200 stores up to 8 hours of BPM data.
• EXCLUSIVE SUNNYFIT APP - Get access to 1000+ training videos from certified trainers. Customize workout plans, explore the world with 10000+ world tours videos, access in-app social communities, leaderboards, challenges & other exciting features.
• PREMIUM COMFORT AND DURABILITY - The compact HR200 is complemented by the high-quality Lycra armbands, a highly elastic synthetic fabric, our product offers superior comfort and lasting durability. The adjustable design ensures a customized fit.
• EASY CHARGING - Recharge the HR200 with the magnetic charger. Track battery life via SunnyFit app or LED indicators. HRM provides 16-20 hours of intense workouts & 160 days of standby, powered by a rechargeable lithium battery & low battery indicator. 

• DURABLE WATER RESISTANCE - IPX7 waterproof rating, this heart rate monitor can withstand 1 meter of water for up to 30 minutes. Whether you're sweating it out during workouts or caught in the rain, your device remains protected.
• UNIVERSAL COMPATIBILITY - Utilize Bluetooth/ANT+ dual-band technology, compatible with fitness apps; Wahoo, Garmin, Peloton, Polar Beat, Strava, and Zwift. Enjoy effortless data synchronization and fitness tracking.
• Sunny Health & Fitness Commitment - A top fitness brand for 20+ years, offering superior products and a dedication to excellence. Count on our committed customer service and enjoy peace of mind with a 1-year warranty on the structural frame.
• Assembled Product Dimensions: 1.83L x 1.41W x 0.55H in

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Exercise Cycling 2-in-1 Advanced Cadence/RPM + Speed Sensor for Indoor or Outdoor Bikes - CB110S
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Tracking your fitness has been made easy, get everything you need to accurately measure your cycling metrics with the Sunny Health & Fitness Exercise Cycling 2-in-1 Cadence + Speed Sensor - CB110. Installation is easy so you can stay focused on your exercise. This sensor is Bluetooth and ANT+ enabled which allows you to connect seamlessly with any mobile device. Use this to track your Cadence / RPM as well as your speed during indoor cycling or on the road while exercising outdoor! Two LED lights indicate the sensor's device connection: blue light signifies cadence mode and red light represents speed mode; please refer to the user manual for more details on the lights. Sync with the Sunny Health & Fitness SunnyFit® App for the best cycling experience.
• 【Connected Fitness Experience】With Bluetooth connectivity, the Sunny Bike Cadence CB110 allows you to connect your bike to the Free SunnyFit App to track real-time workout metrics such as time, RPM, speed, and calories, and get access to 1000+ training videos from world-class certified trainers. Customize your workout plans, explore the world with 10000+ world tours videos, and access exclusive in-app social communities, leaderboards, and other exciting features.
• 【2 in 1 Cadence Sensor】The Sunny bike cadence can be used for both your indoor cycle and outdoor bike. With one simple click in the app, you can switch between different modes and enjoy the full benefits of SunnyFit.
• 【REAL-TIME Metrics】Track and view your workout status such as time, speed, RPM, distance, and calories (based on your age, gender, and weight) in real-time by connecting with the SunnyFit App, and get more accurate and useful data that will help you reach your fitness goals.
• 【EASY INSTALLATION】Simply place the sensor onto the protective, rubberized mat, then wrap and secure it around the bike's crank with the taut elastic bands or cable ties provided for a snug and secure attachment.
• 【Easy to Use】Two LED lights indicate the sensor's device connection and mode, with the blue light signifying cadence mode and the red light representing speed mode. Lights flash to show the sensor's status: power on, wake up, broadcast, and connect. Please refer to the user manual for full details.
• 【EASY Maintenance and Long Duration】The Sunny Bike Cadence sensor is very energy-efficient, and the battery can last very long. The user-friendly, unique design makes it very easy to replace the battery, and the sensor is also water-resistant, allowing for peace of mind while riding outdoors.
• 【WHAT'S INCLUDED】1 Sensor, 2 Rubber Mats, 2 Large Rubber Bands, 2 Small Rubber Bands, 6 Plastic Cable Ties, and an easy-to-follow Instruction Manual. Product dimensions: 3.4 x 3 x 1 inches. 

• 【About SUNNY】For over 20 years, Sunny Health & Fitness has been a premier brand of high-quality fitness products, recognized for our commitment to excellence. Our dedicated customer service reps and fitness instructors stand behind every product to ensure you have the best fitness experience possible.

fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Our Smart Scale is built with the latest technology designed to measure your most important health metrics precisely and accurately. With 20 features to measure your body's weight and holistic composition, this scale is an advanced fitness tool that can hold you accountable to your personal fitness goals. Featuring convenient Bluetooth connectivity, you can sync your real-time health metrics to our digital health center on the Free SunnyFit app. View your data in the app and gain access to hundreds of free fitness programs, taught by our professionally certified trainers. This scale comes with 3 AAA batteries and has a portable, compact design so it can easily be stored out of the way when not being used.
【20 HEALTH METRICS】Accurately measure as many as 20 different essential health metrics, including body weight, ideal weight, BMI, BMR, Visceral Fat, Body Fat, Fat Mass, Muscle Mass, Subcutaneous Fat, Heart Rate, and more.
【FREE CONNECTED APP】Enjoy FREE access to the SunnyFit App with every Sunny Health & Fitness product—no membership fees! Access your personal health center, view metrics over time, track your progress, and gain access to 1000+ trainer-led workouts
【IN-DEPTH BODY ANALYSIS】Each of the 20-health metrics can give even more information with just a tap on SunnyFit. See target weights, recommended ranges, progress, articles, and more for every metric to have a deeper understanding of your progress.
【HIGH ACCURACY BODY FAT SCALE】4 high-precision sensors on our scale give weight metrics within 0.1LB and various other health metrics. Always know and track how your journey is coming with reliable and accurate data.
【400 LB MAX WEIGHT】Tempered glass covering provides a sleek, minimal, yet sturdy design. Combine with the high-quality plastic body, our digital weight scale supports up to 400 LBs of weight, fitting perfectly with a variety of users.
【TRACK YOUR FITNESS JOURNEY】Through the SunnyFit app, track daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly stats for all 20-health metrics. Learn your strengths and weaknesses, then with precise, accurate charts and trends form a plan to meet those goals.
【DIGITAL DISPLAY】The LED display brightly and clearly shows your weight and other vital metrics. The screen is flush to the surface of the scale providing a sleek look.
【AUTO ON & OFF】 When you want to check your weight, simply step on the scale to power it on. Once you're done, the scale will power off if left idle.
【SMART REMINDERS】This Bluetooth compatible weighted scale notifies you when the battery is low. If the weight capacity is exceeded, a warning notification will appear.
【PREMIER US-BASED BRAND】With 20+ years of excellence, Sunny Health & Fitness delivers top-notch equipment dedicated to excellence. With our devoted support team and certified trainers enjoy an unmatched FIT FOR EVERYONE experience.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Active 36" Fitness Trampoline
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Stay active at home with the Sunny Health & Fitness Active 36-Inch Fitness Trampoline( SF-S025063), designed for low-impact cardio, balance training, and everyday movement. This rebounder uses a spring-free elastic bungee system that absorbs up to 85% of impact, helping reduce stress on joints while delivering a smooth, controlled bounce that stays quiet indoors. Built with a reinforced steel frame and six thickened support legs, the trampoline supports up to 300 lbs and stays stable during use. The 5-level adjustable handlebar adds confidence and control, making it suitable for beginners, seniors, recovery workouts, and more intense cardio sessions. The high-density, breathable jumping mat provides long-lasting comfort and responsiveness for daily workouts. Whether you’re working toward an active, healthy lifestyle, adding holistic movement to your routine, or looking for a joint-friendly way to stay consistent, this rebounder fits seamlessly into your home and your schedule.
【LOW-IMPACT CARDIO, EASY ON JOINTS】Enjoy the benefits of running without the harsh impact on joints. The high-tension bungee system absorbs 85% of impact for an enjoyable, quiet workout that helps burn calories and support overall health
【ADVANCED 20-BUNGEE SYSTEM】The springless design uses 20 individual bungees for a quieter, smoother rebounding experience, with multiple secure anchor points for reliable support. An included installation tool helps make bungee setup easier during assembly.
【5-LEVEL ADJUSTABLE HANDLEBAR】The built-in stability support improves balance, posture, and control during workouts. The handlebar adjusts to 5 height levels for a customized fit, giving users added confidence for safer rebounding.
【300 LB CAPACITY & QUIET SUPPORT】 Built with a heavy-duty reinforced steel frame to support up to 300 lb. Six thickened legs with suction cups help keep the rebounder stable, while the mesh cover helps protect feet from slipping through the bungees.
 【FITS YOUR HOME AND YOUR SCHEDULE】No gym, no schedule, no excuses. The space-saving 36-inch design makes it easy to move rooms, ensuring a quick workout is always within reach whenever you have a few minutes to spare
【COMPACT DESIGN WITH FOLDING CAPABILITY】Start your fitness journey right out of the box with our straightforward, user-friendly assembly. While the compact frame is perfect to leave out for daily use, it features a secure locking-bolt hinge that allows you to fold the unit for moving or long-term storage
【EST. IN SUNNY CALIFORNIA SINCE 2002】Sunny Health & Fitness delivers premium equipment with a commitment to quality. Backed by U.S.-based support and certified trainers, we offer a truly unmatched “Fit for Everyone” experience

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Multi-Grip Yoga & Pilates Stretch Strap
fields.N: 1 year structural frame, 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
If you're tired of stiff muscles or limited flexibility, this 75-inch Yoga Stretch Strap is the perfect tool to help you safely reach further and hold poses longer. Featuring 8 individual loops, it acts as a built-in progress tracker, allowing you to visually see your flexibility improve as you move deeper into stretches without fumbling with buckles. Unlike "bouncy" elastic bands, our 100% durable polyester provides the zero-stretch stability that experts and physical therapists recommend for deep, static recovery. We’ve designed the strap 1.5 inches wide to distribute pressure evenly, ensuring it never "digs in" to your hands or feet during a heavy pull. With reinforced precision stitching at every connection, you can put your full weight into every move with total confidence. Compact enough to toss in any bag, it’s a professional-grade solution built to relieve back pain, open tight shoulders, and improve your posture wherever you go.
【SAFELY DEEPEN YOUR STRETCHES WITH 8 GRIP LOOPS】 Whether you are a beginner or recovering in physical therapy, the 8 built-in loops let you easily track your progress. You can adjust your hand or foot placement as you get more flexible, allowing you to increase your range of motion without the risk of overstretching.
【HOLD POSES SECURELY WITH ZERO-STRETCH FABRIC】 Unlike elastic bands that bounce or snap back, this 100% polyester strap provides continuous, stable support. The non-stretch material is exactly what experts recommend for deep, static stretching and improving your daily posture.
【STRETCH IN COMFORT WITHOUT THE STRAP DIGGING IN】 Standard 1-inch straps can often pinch your hands or the arches of your feet during a heavy pull. At 1.5 inches wide, this strap distributes the pressure evenly, so you can hold long hamstring or shoulder stretches without skin irritation.
【PRECISION STITCHED FOR YOUR SAFETY】 We use heavy-duty, precision stitching at every loop connection to ensure the strap can handle high-tension workouts without fraying or snapping. You can focus on strengthening your core and back with total confidence in your gear.
【EXERCISE WITH CONFIDENCE USING REINFORCED STITCHING】 We use heavy-duty, precision stitching at every loop connection so the fabric can handle high-tension workouts without tearing. You can safely put your full body weight into strengthening your core and back, knowing the seams are built to hold.
【EST. IN SUNNY CALIFORNIA SINCE 2002】 Sunny Health & Fitness delivers premium equipment with a commitment to quality. Backed by U.S.-based support and certified trainers, we offer a truly unmatched “Fit for Everyone” experience.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness 12" Yoga Foam Roller (Black) - SF-ER01-BK-12
fields.N: 1 year structural frame, 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
The Sunny Health & Fitness High-Density EPP Foam Roller is built for firm, controlled pressure—not soft cushioning. Its intentionally hard construction helps transfer body weight into focused pressure while resisting compression and maintaining dependable support through repeated rolling, stretching, and exercise. Choose from four lengths to match your routine: the compact 12" and 18" sizes are ideal for targeted muscle work and easier maneuverability, while the 24" provides versatile coverage and the 36" offers more surface area for the back, legs, and larger movements. Use it before or after activity for stretching, mobility work, warmups, cooldowns, and everyday recovery when muscles feel tired or tight. Lightweight yet durable EPP foam makes it easy to move, store, or bring to the gym. Every size is available in Black, Blue, or Pink. For even more workout variety, access trainer-led stretching, mobility, yoga, and fitness sessions through the free SunnyFit App.
【FIRM BY DESIGN FOR DEEPER PRESSURE】 Made from high-density EPP foam, this roller is intentionally hard—not soft or cushioned—so it can help transfer your body weight into focused pressure while resisting compression and staying supportive through each roll.
【12" & 18" FOR TARGETED MUSCLE WORK】 Choose the shorter sizes for more precise pressure on calves, arms, shoulders, feet, and smaller muscle areas. Their compact length also makes them easier to maneuver, carry, and store in smaller spaces.
【24" & 36" FOR MORE BODY COVERAGE】 Choose the 24" for a balance of targeted and broader rolling, or the 36" for the back, legs, and larger muscle groups. Longer lengths provide more surface area for smoother rolling with less repositioning.
【FULL-BODY RELIEF FOR TIRED, TIGHT MUSCLES】 Use the firm foam roller before or after activity for full-body stretching, mobility work, warmups, cooldowns, and everyday recovery to help ease tight areas and support more comfortable movement.
【DURABLE EPP FOAM THAT HOLDS ITS SHAPE】 Expanded polypropylene foam is lightweight, durable, and built to resist compression while maintaining the firm support needed for repeated rolling, stretching, and exercise.
【3 COLORS AVAILABLE IN EVERY SIZE】 Choose Black, Blue, or Pink to match your space or style, with all three color options available across the 12", 18", 24", and 36" foam roller sizes.
【FREE SUNNYFIT APP WORKOUTS】 Add more variety to your routine with free access to trainer-led workouts, yoga, stretching, mobility sessions, and other guided fitness content in the SunnyFit App.
【EST. IN SUNNY CALIFORNIA SINCE 2002】Sunny Health & Fitness delivers premium equipment with a commitment to quality. Backed by U.S.-based support and certified trainers, we offer a truly unmatched “Fit for Everyone” experience.

fields.AU:
Sunny Health Fitness Heavy Duty Ankle Straps - the ultimate fitness accessory designed to enhance and endure. Made for the dedicated individual, these straps are constructed with durability in mind, featuring reinforced stitching and a weight that speaks to their quality. Comfort meets functionality with our ergonomically designed straps. The shock-absorbent padding ensures your ankles are protected, allowing you to focus solely on your workout. Say goodbye to the distraction of discomfort and hello to prolonged, effective sessions. Whether you’re at home or on the go, their adjustable fit and portable design make them a convenient addition to any workout routine. These ankle straps are versatile, compatible with a vast array of exercises that target the lower body. They offer the added benefit of resistance to your regular routine, making each movement more challenging and rewarding. The sleek, minimalistic design not only provides a professional look but also ensures that functionality is at the forefront, allowing for an optimal workout experience. In essence, these ankle straps are not just an accessory; they are an investment in your fitness goals. Designed to activate and enhance your muscles more effectively, they promise to be an indispensable part of your workout arsenal, assisting you in achieving the toned and strong physique you work towards. Choose our ankle straps for a reliable, comfortable, and versatile workout experience.
【ALL-IN-ONE VERSATILE WORKOUT】These ankle straps are a comprehensive tool for a variety of lower body exercises. Effortlessly switch between exercises like cable kickbacks, leg lifts, hip abductions, thigh contractions, lunges & mountain climbers. 
【HEAVY DUTY, DURABLE & LONG-LASTING】Crafted with reinforced stitching & high-grade materials, these straps withstand demanding workouts. Features include heavy-duty metal D-rings and strap, ensuring secure connections to equipment.
【ULTIMATE COMFORT WITH SHOCK ABSORBENT PADDING】Ankle straps are equipped with shock-absorbing padding, providing optimal comfort & reducing stress on your ankles. The ergonomically designed 1.4-inch thick neoprene padding ensures comfort.
【COMPATIBILITY】Designed with universal fit in mind, our ankle straps are compatible with standard cable systems, resistance trainers & most exercise equipment that requires ankle cuffs, ensuring a wide range of use across various workout routines.
【ADJUSTABLE FIT】Adjustable fit that secure & snug feel for ankles of all sizes. Minimal Design Combining superior functionality with a sleek, professional design, the ankle straps not only excel in performance but also in enhancing aesthetics.
【HOW TO USE】Effortlessly attach these ankle straps to any cable machine by securing the strap around your ankle, adjust for a snug fit, and start your leg and glute exercises such as kickbacks, leg extensions, and hip abductions.
【WHERE TO USE】Portable and ideal for gym-goers and home fitness enthusiasts alike, use these versatile ankle straps at the gym, home, or any workout environment with a compatible cable or resistance training machine. 
【Sunny Health & Fitness Commitment】A top fitness brand for 20+ years, offers superior products and a dedication to excellence. Count on our committed customer service and enjoy peace of mind with a 1-year warranty on the structural frame.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Adjustable Weighted Vest 4-10lbs
fields.N: 1 year structural frame, 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Add resistance to the movement you already do with the Sunny Health & Fitness Adjustable Weighted Vest. Choose from three progressive weight ranges—4–10 lb, 11–20 lb, or 20–32 lb—to match your fitness level, workout style, and resistance goals. Each vest starts with a built-in base weight and includes 6 removable inserts, allowing you to add or remove weight as your training progresses. The X-Balance design helps distribute weight evenly, while independent insert compartments help reduce shifting during walking, jogging, weighted walking, squats, lunges, step-ups, push-ups, and bodyweight workouts. Adjustable side webbing straps and quick-release buckles help create a secure fit, while reflective accents support low-light visibility and a front small-item zipper pocket keeps essentials within reach. Compact, wearable, and easy to use, this weighted vest helps make everyday workouts more challenging without holding dumbbells or using bulky equipment.
【PICK THE RIGHT TRAINING WEIGHT】Choose the adjustable weighted vest that fits your workout style. The 4–10 lb vest is best for lighter training, walking, lighter jogging, and users new to weighted vest training. The 11–20 lb vest supports moderate walking, jogging, bodyweight training, and home workout circuits. The 20–32 lb vest is best for heavier weighted walking, strength circuits, and more demanding bodyweight workouts.
【PROGRESS WITH REMOVABLE WEIGHTS】Each vest starts with a built-in base weight and includes 6 removable sand inserts so you can add resistance gradually. The 4–10 lb vest includes six 1 lb weights, the 11–20 lb vest includes six 1.5 lb weights, and the 20–32 lb vest includes six 2 lb weights.
【MOVE WITH BETTER BALANCE】The X-Balance design helps distribute weight across the vest for better movement control. Independent weight compartments help reduce shifting during walking, squats, lunges, and bodyweight circuits.
【STAYS SECURE WHILE YOU TRAIN】Adjustable side webbing straps and quick-release buckles help create a secure fit before you train. Excess strap loops help keep loose ends tucked away and reduce workout distractions.
【TRAIN OUTDOORS WITH ESSENTIALS】Reflective details help improve visibility during outdoor walking or low-light workouts, while the front small-item zipper pocket keeps keys, cards, or other essentials within reach.
【ADD RESISTANCE TO YOUR ROUTINE】Add wearable resistance to walking, jogging, weighted walking, squats, lunges, step-ups, push-ups, and bodyweight workouts without holding dumbbells or using bulky fitness equipment.
【EST. IN SUNNY CALIFORNIA SINCE 2002】Sunny Health & Fitness delivers premium equipment with a commitment to quality. Backed by U.S.-based support and certified trainers, we offer a truly unmatched “Fit for Everyone” experience.

fields.N: 3 year structural frame, 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Experience hardcore cardio training at home with this 300lb capacity indoor cycling bike. Micro-adjustable magnetic resistance and a quiet belt-drive system deliver smooth, challenging rides, while a 4-way adjustable seat and handlebars let you dial in your perfect posture. The built-in monitor with pulse sensors tracks time, speed, distance, calories, and RPM, and Bluetooth connects to the SunnyFit app for guided rides and personalized AI-powered plans. Stay engaged with the easy-reach dumbbell holder for upper body workouts and keep essentials close with the device and bottle holder. The wide inseam range fits different rider heights while protecting joints, and adjustable stabilizers ensure steady, safe rides on any surface. Backed by Sunny Health & Fitness, a trusted U.S.-based company since 2002, this bike brings a complete, connected cycling experience to your home.

【FREE APP-INTEGRATED RIDING, AI-POWERED FITNESS PLAN】Enjoy lifetime SunnyFit app access with cycling programs, real-time metrics, trainer-led rides, explore scenic routes, and AI-generated personalized plans based on your body index for smarter training.
【MICRO-ADJUSTABLE RESISTANCE, QUIET & SMOOTH RIDING】Enjoy a silent, fluid ride with belt-drive and micro-adjustable magnetic resistance. The Push-down emergency stop lets you ride with confidence during intense sessions.

fields.AU:
Enjoy smooth, smart, and customizable indoor cycling with the SF-B124066. Stay safe and in control with the push-down emergency brake, and easily monitor your performance metrics—including speed, time, distance, calories, and RPM—via the built-in digital display. Lightweight yet sturdy, this 60 lb bike supports riders up to 265 lbs, making it ideal for focused, effective home workouts that elevate your cardio fitness.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Smart Recumbent Cross Trainer Elliptical Exercise Bike – SF-RB4886 SMART
fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
Enjoy low-impact yet premium-quality workouts with the Smart Recumbent Elliptical Cross Trainer. Designed for optimal comfort, take your workout to the next level with 16 levels of electromagnetic resistance. Take advantage of the 12 pre-programmed workouts or 4 customizable user programs for a unique and personalized workout experience. Improve your cardiovascular health and muscular strength, keep your joints healthy, and stay connected in the SunnyFit® App with the Smart Recumbent Elliptical Cross Trainer!
• FITNESS APP EXPERIENCE: Download and join the SunnyFit® App community to access an array of free, professional trainer-led strength workouts and hundreds of other fitness programs. In the app, track your progress, set fitness goals, access personalized workout plans, and compete with other community members to get to the top of the leaderboard. Have any workout of your choice right at your fingertips, while also feeling supported and inspired as a member of this like-minded community.
• ELECTROMAGNETIC RESISTANCE: With 16 different levels of electromagnetic resistance, you will be able to set your workout intensity level to perfectly meet your needs. Crank up the resistance for a challenging full-body workout, or dial it down for a low-impact and low-intensity recovery session.
• WORKOUT VARIETY: Take the guesswork out of your exercise session and use one of the 12 pre-programmed elliptical workouts built into the machine. If you prefer to customize your own workout, the Smart Recumbent Elliptical Cross Trainer allows you to create up to 4 unique user programs for a personalized workout experience.
• DESIGNED FOR LOW-IMPACT: Protect your joints while still challenging yourself. Our recumbent elliptical allows you to improve cardiovascular health and build strength but is also gentle on your body.
• FULL BODY WORKOUT: Work various muscle groups in both your upper and lower body by simultaneously using the moveable handles and elliptical-sized foot pedals. If you want a more focused workout, use the handles or foot pedals independently for a targeted upper or lower body burn.
• EASY ON AND OFF: The easy on-off design provides a simple, hassle-free transition from start to finish. With minimal obstruction between the handlebars and the seat, you can step through your machine and sit down safely before starting your workout.
• COMFORTABLE RIDE: Enjoy the padded seat and contoured mesh back support for a more comfortable and pleasant workout. With the easy seat adjuster, you no longer need to get off the machine to adjust the seat to your height. Simply engage the handle by your side and adjust to your comfort level.
• BOTTLE HOLDER: Conveniently placed in the center of your machine, the bottle holder allows you to store your water bottle close by and keep you hydrated through your toughest workouts.
• DEVICE HOLDER: Secure your phone or tablet in the centrally located device holder. Stay entertained during your workouts and stream your favorite TV show, or dial in your exercise session with a trainer-led workout in the SunnyFit app." 
• PERFORMANCE MONITOR: Track various fitness metrics during each workout. View your time, speed, RPM, distance, Watts, calories, heart rate, target heart rate, and resistance on the digital performance monitor. Train at your perfect intensity level every workout!

Cycle into fitness with the SF-RB4850 Programmable Recumbent Bike by Sunny Health & Fitness. Slide your feet onto the universal pedals that have textured grips and universal straps for optimal stability. Sit comfortably on the wide recumbent bike seat, equipped with breathable mesh back support. Use the easy-to-use seat adjustment lever to modify your distance from the pedals (leg inseam 30 inches to 40 inches). Take advantage of the step-through design to easily mount and dismount the cardio machine. Made for enduring workouts, the cardio stationary bike has a 300 lb user weight capacity. Place your phone or tablet onto the device holder. Use the bottle holder to keep your favorite drink in arm’s reach. Maintain stability when you exercise by adjusting the ground levelers. Designed for easy moving, use the lift handle on the rear of the recumbent stationary bike to move the bike from room to room by using the onboard transportation wheels.

fields.AU:
Discover the ultimate fitness companion with the Sunny Health & Fitness 2-in-1 Mini Exercise Bike. This innovative pedal exerciser offers effortless exercise for everyone, providing low-impact workouts without joint strain. Ideal for office staff, seniors, athletes in recovery, and physical therapy patients, its versatile 2-in-1 design allows for both leg and arm workouts, catering to your entire body's fitness needs. Experience the convenience of a compact and portable build, making storage and transportation a breeze. Enjoy a silent and smooth workout with the friction belt-drive and stepless micro-adjustment feature, offering varied intensity options. Stay motivated and track your progress in real-time with the onboard digital monitor, displaying Speed, Time, Distance, and Calories Burned. Plus, dive into a connected fitness experience by syncing via Bluetooth, giving you access to a vast array of training videos, global tours, fitness programs, and community engagements. With Sunny Health & Fitness, a trusted brand with over 20 years of expertise, embark on your fitness journey with confidence, convenience, and commitment to your well-being.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Smart Motorized Mini Exercise Bike with 18 Speed Levels SF-B024041
fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
The Sunny Smart Motorized Mini Exercise Bike brings convenient, low-impact movement to your daily routine. Whether used under a desk or on a table, it offers smooth cycling for both arms and legs. It is great for staying active at home, at work, or during recovery. Choose from 18 speed levels or 6 pre-programmed workouts designed specifically for seniors and rehabilitation.Use it plugged in for hands-free powered motion or pedal manually without power. The remote lets you adjust speed, direction, or mode without reaching down, while the clear display shows your time, speed, and calories burned. Connect to the SunnyFit app for real-time metrics, guided workouts, scenic routes, and optional heart rate tracking with Apple Watch or the Sunny HR200 sensor (sold separately).
•	GENTLE FULL-BODY MOVEMENT, ANYTIME: Rotate with your arms or legs to stay active from head to toe. Great for low-impact, full-body workouts without leaving your chair.
•	FREE APP-INTEGRATED RIDING, SIMPLE GUIDED SUPPORT: Your minibike includes lifetime access to the SunnyFit app with motorized-friendly programs, real-time metrics, and guided sessions. Pedal through world landscapes or follow expert-led routines—no subscription needed.
•	POWERED TWO-WAY CYCLING，BOOSTS MOBILITY & MORE: Automatic pedal assist gently cycles your arms or legs for you, helping boost circulation and mobility without strain. Perfect for rehab, post-op recovery & daily cardio routine.
•	18 SPEEDS + MANUAL MODE, CHOOSE YOUR OWN PACE: Choose from 18 speed levels for the pace that suits you best, or unplug and pedal manually anytime, no power needed.
•	6 PRE-TUNED PROGRAMS, JUST PRESS AND GO: Each program is carefully calibrated for seniors and recovery, safe, structured, and easy to follow at your own pace.
•	CLEAR MONITOR & SEAMLESS CONTROL: See your time, speed, and calories at a glance. The built-in screen and control panel keep things easy, clear, and right at your fingertips.
•	REST ASSURED WITH AUTO-STOP SAFETY: A built-in sensor detects unusual pressure or resistance and stops the pedaling automatically giving you peace of mind with every session.
•	STAY SEATED, NO REACHING DOWN: Adjust speed, change direction, switch programs, or stop motion, all from the remote. No bending, stretching, or getting up required.
•	HEART RATE SYNC FOR SAFETY & PRECISION: Pair the SunnyFit app with your Apple Watch for basic heart rate tracking. Connecting with Sunny HR200 sensor (sold separately) for accurate monitoring and alerts when you exceed your target zone.
•	U.S.-BASED COMPANY, TRUSTED SINCE 2002: Sunny Health & Fitness has served millions of households with reliable, user-friendly equipment for all ages and needs. Backed by expert support and certified trainers, we’re committed to making fitness accessible to everyone.

fields.AU:
Bring the Pilates studio experience home with the Sunny Health & Fitness SF-PM20 Complete Home Pilates Reformer Set. This foldable Pilates reformer includes a reformer box, removable jump board, double-loop straps, adjustable pulley risers, easy-adjust rope system, and 5 color-coded resistance springs to support low-impact strength, flexibility, mobility, posture, balance, and core training. The included reformer box and jump board expand your workout variety with options for traditional reformer exercises, stretching, lower-body conditioning, balance work, and low-impact cardio-style movement. The 5-spring resistance system includes two 10 lb springs, two 15 lb springs, and one 28 lb spring, allowing you to mix and match resistance levels for different exercises and progression.
Customize your setup with a 5-angle footbar, 3-angle head pad, 3-height pulley risers, and adjustable rope system for better comfort, alignment, and exercise variety. Designed for home fitness, the foldable frame and four transport wheels make it easier to store and move between workouts. Built with a durable steel frame, smooth-gliding carriage, premium cushioning, and TPR wheels, the SF-PM20 delivers a quiet, supportive Pilates experience. It supports users up to 300 lbs and up to 6 ft 3 in tall. Backed by Sunny Health & Fitness, a trusted name in fitness with 20+ years of experience, the SF-PM20 helps you move better, feel stronger, and enjoy a FIT FOR EVERYONE Pilates experience at home.

fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
The Sunny Health & Fitness Powerzone Squat Rack SF-XF9931 will help you take your home gym workouts to the next level. Combining with our Sunny Health & Fitness bars & bumper plates, perform workouts to target & strengthen muscles across your body. The powder-coating, durability, and utility are designed seamlessly into the Powerzone squat rack workout bench to fully support weight and powerlifting workouts. With the Sunny Health & Fitness squat power rack, you get a fully loaded power tower with features such as raised height pull-up bar with 8 settings, 6 exercise band attachment points, durable J hooks, and spotter's arms, as well as more than 18 adjustment points, to fit people of all sizes. Hardware peg hole diameter: 3/4 inch. *Olympic Barbell and Weight Plates sold separate*
【HEAVY-DUTY FRAME】 Constructed with premium quality steel construction, this power rack supports up to an incredible 805 lbs max weight capacity barbell.
【ANGLED PULL UP BAR】 The pull-up bar is adjustable and reversible with 8 different positions and angled for both wide and narrow grip pull-ups.
【SPOTTER ARMS】 you will always have a spotter in the Powerzone Squat Rack with safety lock latches for ease of mind and safety assurance when squatting with heavier weights.
【OLYMPIC PLATE STORAGE】 With safety clips, organize weights on racks while adding extra stability when utilizing the machine. (Weights NOT included).
【OLYMPIC BARS】 Fits up to 7ft Olympic Bars.
【RESISTANCE BAND POSTS】 6 Resistance Band pins (3 per side) to increase versatility add extra resistance for your lifts and squats. (when using resistance bands, weight plate storage should be fully stacked to prevent tip-over).

fields.N: 1 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
The Sunny Health & Fitness Powerzone Power Cage is a full-sized weight cage and an effective tool to give you strength training workouts a powerful boost. Pump up your weightlifting reps, push your squats, flex your trap muscles or abductors; this home gym power rack – with a 1000 LB max carry weight – can help you make serious progressive gains! Whether you want to focus on your slow or fast-twitch muscles, the Powerzone is versatile enough for a comprehensive total workout experience. Hardware peg hole diameter: 3/4 inch.
【ULTRA STRENGTH AND DURABILITY】 Capable of carrying a max weight of 1000 LB the Powerzone Power Cage is for serious strength training enthusiasts.
【SPOTTER BARS】 you will always have a spotter in the Powerzone Power Cage with safety lock latches for ease of mind and safety assurance when squatting with heavier weights.
【ANGLED PULL UP BAR】 The pull-up bar is adjustable and reversible with 4 different positions and angled for both wide and narrow grip pull-ups.
【STABLE AND GROUNDED】 Store extra-weight plates with the included safety clips to increase stability and peace of mind. The Powerzone Power Cage may also be bolted down to establish a firm and stable base as well.
【ADJUSTABLE AND VERSATILE】 18 vertical height settings allow for various adjustments of the J-Hooks.
【TEXTURED GRIP】 The knurled pattern textured grip on the pull-up bars provides extra grip and prevents hand slippage.

fields.AU:
Get back to the basics with the Squat Stand Power Rack. This rack’s minimalistic design and small footprint make it perfect for any sized living space. With the ability to adjust the rack to different heights, you can perform standard barbell lifts, as well as use the adjustable 3-level pull-up bar as part of your strength training routine. Customize your workout experience further with the compatible accessories (SF-XFA001-SF-XFA007) to help you hit all your fitness goals!
【COMPACT DESIGN】 This power rack is designed to take up minimal space in your home gym, while also allowing you to get the most out of your workouts. The minimalistic design and small footprint make it perfect for any sized living space.
【3-LEVEL PULL-UP BAR】 The pull-up bar is adjustable up to 3 levels so it can be modified to comfortably fit your height. Maximize your upper body strength by targeting various upper body muscle groups, depending on your pull-up grip.
【ADJUSTABILITY】 Highly adjustable with 18 different height settings, this rack can be modified to fit your body size. Just simply slide and set the J-Hooks or any attachment to your desired preference.
【WEIGHT PLATE STORAGE】 Conveniently store any extra and unused weights on the 1” plate holders which are designed to hold up to 100 lbs. each.
【CUSTOMIZABLE】 While the indoor squat rack comes with J-hooks, you can attach additional equipment like a dip bar (SF-XFA002), a bar holder attachment (SF-XFA003), a landmine attachment (SF-XFA004), a U-Ring attachment (SF-XFA005), or a lat pulldown attachment (SF-XFA006). Please note, SF-XFA003 and SF-XFA004 need to be purchased together for it to be fully functional.
【MULTIFUNCTIONAL WORKOUTS】 Use the rack for weightlifting, resistance band workouts, and a 3-level height adjustable pull-up bar—put your physical fitness to the test! No pain, no gain.
【STURDY SUPPORT】 Featuring a durable carbon steel frame that can withstand your most intense resistance workouts, this rack is sure to feel sturdy throughout even your most intense workouts. Its walk-in design ensures easy access, while the industrial style implements safety and great functionality. The adjustable J-hooks can be modified to different height options convenient for various lifting exercises and height requirements. These hooks are designed to hold up to 300 lbs.

fields.AU:
Get the gains you desire and set a personal record and then aim to push beyond your limits with the Sunny Health & Fitness SF-XF920020. This Smith Machine is a total body complete home gym featuring a multi-grip pull-up bar, a 15-pound barbell with safety clips, weight plate storage, and a high degree of adjustability. In addition, it is designed to allow for potential expansion of features and function with it being fully compatible with Sunny Health & Fitness Power Zone Power Rack Accessories Collection. • HIGH MAX LOAD: Power through to your limits and beyond; from squats and bench presses to pull-ups the immense max weight capacity ensures this power cage is resilient enough to withstand your most intense workouts. *Squat Bar fits 1-inch diameter barbells only*
• ADJUSTABILITY: Highly adjustable with 21 different height settings, this power cage can fit most users.
• SPOTTER BLOCKS: Rubber-lined safety bars stand vigilant in ensuring that you’re always protected in case of exercise emergencies or issues. Therefore, you can keep your mind laser-focused on your goals.

• PULL-UP BAR: Dedicated pull-up bar enables users to take advantage of the various grips to work and target specific upper body muscle groups.

• SAFETY CLIPS: Included safety clips are essential to maintaining your extra weight plates are secure and stable.
• EXTERNAL J-HOOK: Dual J-Hooks with rubber padding lets you add an additional barbell for free weights.

fields.AU:
Develop strength, speed, and leanness with the Sunny Health & Fitness No. 077S Home Squat Machine. Strengthen not only your lower body but your shoulders, arms, and back, this exerciser promotes compound movement (two or more muscle groups working cohesively). Activating groups of muscles together require more strength, so you'll burn more calories. Compound exercises bring compounded results! With 3 adjustable resistance bands, intensify your workout by adding or subtracting bands, each band adds approx. 22 pounds of resistance!
• WHY SQUAT: Squats are not only effective for building an insanely strong lower body, but also because they deliver a number of ancillary physical benefits, including increased hormone release and improved flexibility.
• HOW IT WORKS: Tone the lower body by using your glutes, quads, and hamstrings to push down to a squat. Work your shoulders, back, and chest as you push yourself up through every rep. Skip the weights, this squat trainer will reduce the amount of stress on the knees and joints that occurs when you squat incorrectly. Adding this to your workout will help you develop a proper form to get the perfect squat.
• TRACK YOUR FITNESS: The LCD monitor tracks your calories, scan, time, and count. This trainer gives you the freedom to add or remove tension, the three elastic bands can be clipped on or off the seat to adjust to any fitness level.
• WORKOUT VARIETY: Not only does it offer the ability to do a full-range squat but you can also add variety by doing high, median and low zone squats pulses.
• CONVENIENCE: Easily store almost anywhere in your home. Remove the knob, fold, and store; as easy as 1, 2, 3. Its self-leveling pedals help you to get in and out of the bike in a breeze. Stable end caps prevent any movement to ensure you have a stable and safe workout.
• ADJUSTABLE: Padded handle and saddle distance control adjust to your body length to develop the proper technique. Not only can you adjust the saddle proximity to the handlebar but it comes equipped with saddle angle control, which allows you to adjust the saddle at 30, 60, and 90 degrees giving you deeper squat positions.

At the heart of its design lies a unique feature: a single loop handlebar that seamlessly transforms into two independent rower bars, allowing you to maximize your workout potential while minimizing stress on your joints. The multi-functional rower & squat assist machine shines as a traditional squat assist machine, providing gentle support and guidance as you work through your squat and rowing exercises. But where it truly stands out is in its ability to adapt to your changing fitness needs, making it perfect for beginners or those recovering from injury. With a simple separation in the middle, the single loop handlebar becomes two independent rower bars, enabling a wide rowing motion that targets different parts of the back with precision. This dual functionality not only enhances the effectiveness of your workouts but also adds a new dimension to your exercise routine. Experience the freedom to customize your workouts and target specific muscle groups with ease. Transition seamlessly between squatting and rowing motions, all within the convenience of a single piece of equipment. Plus, with its adjustable resistance bands and ergonomic design, the dual row and squat ensures a comfortable and effective workout every time, working your core, legs, quads, glutes, upper, and lower back muscles. It's the perfect rehabilitation assistant, offering a less stressful way to rebuild strength and mobility.
• 【ALL-IN-ONE HOME FITNESS】 Transform the single handlebar into two independent rower bars for wider back stroke while providing gentle support for squat exercises, reducing joint strain, and providing upper and lower body workout at the same time.
• 【SQUAT ASSIST】 Low to high impact squat assistant for better leg, calf, glutes, and quads you progress in your fitness journey, ideal for rehabilitation or enhancing your fitness routine at any age, fitness level or physical condition.
• 【INCLUDED FITNESS APP】Download our Free SunnyFit App on your device and access thousands of workout videos led by certified trainers, seamlessly integrating with smart devices for personalized guidance and optimization.
• 【ADJUSTABLE COMFORT】 Experience extended comfort during workouts with adjustable seat and handlebar positions, accommodating various body types for a tailored fitness experience.
• 【DEVICE HOLDER】 Stay entertained with your favorite show or follow along with training videos on your smart device while tracking progress on the digital monitor, enhancing your workout experience.
• 【ADJUSTABLE RESISTANCE】 Four levels of resistance for up to 66 pounds with no resistance band or increase resistance with bands, allowing for progression and tailored intensity to meet fitness goals.
• 【STABLE & SAFE】 Pedals securely hold feet during squats while enabling full ankle movement, ensuring stability and peace of mind during workouts.
• 【ERGONOMIC】 The single/double dual rowing bars target key muscle groups precisely. Close grip engages middle/lower traps and biceps. Medium grip targets upper traps, delts, and lats. Wide grip emphasizes outer lats.
• 【EASY STORAGE】 Foldable for convenient storage in small spaces like offices, apartments, or shared areas, maximizing convenience without compromising on functionality.
• 【20+ YEARS OF EXCELLENCE】As a premier brand, Sunny Health & Fitness delivers top-notch equipment dedicated to excellence. With our devoted support team and certified trainers, enjoy an unmatched FIT FOR EVERYONE experience.

fields.AU:
Discover the ultimate rowing experience with our advanced rowing machine, designed to maximize your cardiovascular workout and enhance muscle activation across your legs, back, core, and arms. Our 360-degree full motion design closely mimics natural rowing, offering a complete range of movement. Experience each row with enhanced realism through our innovative double cord handlebar, designed to strengthen the upper body and improve shoulder mobility. Adjust the intensity of your workout with ease using our 16-level dual cord magnetic system that ensures a near-silent operation. Stay connected and motivated with access to over 1000+ on-demand videos through the free SunnyFit APP and monitor your performance accurately with our LCD monitor and optional HR200 Heart Rate Monitor. Our machine's durability is unmatched, with a high-standard rowing strap that withstands over 360,000 rows, and all rotating parts are equipped with metal bearings to extend longevity. The ultra-long 51.3-inch slide rail accommodates users up to 6.8 feet tall, enhancing the realistic rowing experience. Advanced comfort features include a stainless-steel sliding rail for smooth operation, a handle sleeve to prevent hand wear, and a comfortable cushion for an enjoyable workout. When you're done, the lightweight design and upright storage feature allow for effortless placement and space efficiency in any home setting.

The Sunny Health & Fitness Smart & Flippable Water Rower (SF-RW524022) delivers a smooth, natural rowing experience designed for home training. Its under-tank water resistance system responds dynamically to your effort, recreating the feel of real rowing on water. Pair your rower with the SunnyFit App for scenic workouts, real-time metrics, and AI-guided training plans. The dual-track frame ensures balanced motion without calf contact, while the reinforced steel construction supports up to 300 lbs for lasting durability. A thick padded seat, pivoting pedals, and ergonomic handle keep each stroke comfortable, and the built-in monitor tracks key stats including time/500 M. When finished, simply flip upright and roll away for compact storage.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Full Motion Rower with Ab Trainer
fields.N: 3 year structural frame / 180 days other parts and components
fields.AU:
The Sunny Health & Fitness SF-RW525023 is a 2-in-1 full-motion hydraulic rower and core trainer designed to bring more workout variety to a home fitness space. Unlike traditional rowing machines that rely on a single center-pull handle, this machine uses dual full-motion rowing arms that move together through a wider, more natural path. The design helps create a dynamic rowing experience while engaging the legs, arms, shoulders, upper back, lats, and core.The built-in back-assist core trainer adds another way to exercise without requiring a separate abdominal bench or core machine.
【FULL MOTION ROWING + CORE TRAINING】 Combine full-motion rowing and core-focused exercise in one versatile home fitness machine. Transition between sliding-seat cardio rowing, fixed-seat rowing, and supported abdominal workouts without purchasing separate equipment.
【DUAL ROWING ARMS】 Connected dual rowing arms move together through a wider, more natural path than a traditional center-pull handle, creating dynamic upper-body movement that engages the arms, shoulders, upper back, lats, and core.
【BUILT-IN BACK-ASSIST CORE TRAINER】 The integrated core-training system features a cushioned seat and six foam rollers that provide supportive counter-resistance and comfortable back contact during controlled abdominal and core exercises.
【SLIDING + 5-POSITION LOCKABLE SEAT】 Let the seat glide freely for traditional rowing or secure it at five positions along the rail for fixed-seat rowing, core-engaged rowing, and ab-focused exercises.
【12 HYDRAULIC RESISTANCE LEVELS】 Manually adjust the hydraulic cylinder through 12 resistance levels to match your preferred workout intensity, from lighter movement to more challenging rowing sessions.
【CONNECTED FITNESS EXPERIENCE】Connect to the free SunnyFit app for trainer-led workouts, world tour routes, fitness challenges, progress tracking and AI powered personalize plan .
【400 LB CAPACITY + HOME-FRIENDLY DESIGN】 A supportive frame accommodates users up to 400 lb. Built-in transport wheels make repositioning easier, while adjustable stabilizer end caps help balance the rower on slightly uneven home floors.
【MULTIFUNCTION LCD MONITOR】Track time, count, distance, calories, total count, strokes per minute, and compatible wireless heart rate. Build-in device holders keep your phone or tablet secure during SunnyFit workout sessions.
【EST. IN SUNNY CALIFORNIA SINCE 2002】Sunny Health & Fitness delivers premium equipment with a commitment to quality. Backed by U.S.-based support and certified trainers, we offer a truly unmatched “Fit for Everyone” experience.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness Lateral Stepper with Resistance Bands
fields.AU: The Sunny Health & Fitness SF-S026002 Lateral Stepper with Resistance Bands is designed for users who want compact home cardio with a more dynamic, controlled, and approachable workout feel. Unlike traditional mini steppers that mainly move straight up and down, this lateral stepper moves side to side with a natural pedal height change, creating a more engaging lower-body workout experience. Unlike rocking balance-board style products that use one wide platform, the Sunny design uses two separate pedals and a guided lateral track system to create a more stepper-like side-to-side motion. The result is a compact, low-impact cardio experience that feels more stable, more familiar, and more approachable than a traditional rocking stepper, while still adding upper-body variety with resistance bands.

fields.F: Sunny Health & Fitness SMART Lateral Stepper with Resistance Bands
fields.AU:
Bring more movement into your day with the Sunny Health & Fitness Smart Lateral Stepper with Resistance Bands. Designed for compact home cardio, this smart lateral stepper gives users a different way to step by combining vertical movement with side-to-side travel. Instead of only moving straight up and down like a traditional mini stepper, the guided lateral stepping path helps engage more of the lower body, including the thighs, calves, glutes, hips, inner thighs, outer thighs, and core.
The slightly outward pedal positioning supports a more natural stepping posture, helping users feel more comfortable and in control as they move side to side. Large 5.3" x 12" anti-slip pedals with side guards provide secure foot placement, while the compact frame helps create a stable stepping feel for everyday home use.
The fixed hydraulic resistance provides steady movement without complicated settings, and users can adjust workout effort by changing stepping speed. It is ideal for quick cardio sessions, low-impact lower-body training, and small-space home routines.
Included resistance bands add upper-body movement while you step and can be used for more workout variety. Bluetooth connectivity works with the SunnyFit App to help track workout data, including time, count, calories, and SPM. With low-noise operation and no assembly required, the SF-S024072 makes it easy to unbox, step on, and start moving.

fields.AU:
Elevate your fitness with the SF-T722069 Compact Smart Treadmill with 6 level auto inclines by Sunny Health & Fitness. This treadmill melds functionality with modern convenience for today's professionals. Its sleek design ensures it fits perfectly under desks, enabling calorie burning amidst work. With a 6.3 x 2.4-inch LED, users can effortlessly track Time, Speed, Calories Burned, Steps, and Distance. Its spacious 45.7L x 16W inch surface guarantees optimal comfort.The SunnyFit App enhances the experience with Bluetooth connectivity. Dive into 1000+ workouts and 10,000+ global routes, making goal setting and achieving seamless. For added convenience, a remote control lets users adjust speeds from 0.5 to 3.7 MPH. Safety is paramount, evident in the treadmill's low-impact shock absorption system and active-use detection that pauses the device if inactive for 5 seconds. The additional safety clip further ensures user protection. Environmental consciousness isn't overlooked. The device shifts to power-saving mode if idle for 10 minutes, emphasizing energy efficiency.
For best use, it's recommended to position this treadmill under a desk or near a stable object. Trust in Sunny Health & Fitness is easy with their 20-year legacy in fitness, outstanding products, and dedicated customer service.
