fields.AU:
Embark on an immersive fitness journey with the Sunny Health & Fitness Treadpad® Pacer Dual Mode Walking/Running Treadmill. This Bluetooth-connected treadmill grants access to a vast library of 1000+ training videos, fitness programs, and 10,000+ world tour videos via the Free SunnyFit app. With customizable workouts, real-time progress tracking, and exclusive in-app social communities, this treadmill offers a connected fitness experience like no other. Its dual mode functionality allows for both walking and running, with a speed range of 0.5 to 3.7 mph (0.8-6 km/h) in walking mode and 0.5 to 6 mph (0.8-10 km/h) in running mode, catering to your preferred pace. With a 6-level automatic incline for added challenge, a sleek, low-profile design, a large backlit LED display, remote control operation, and built-in transportation wheels for easy storage, the Sunny Health & Fitness Treadpad® Pacer is the perfect companion on your fitness journey, backed by over 20 years of excellence in the fitness industry.
【SPACE-SAVING & UNDER-DESK DESIGN】This sleek and slim walking treadpad can be easily slid under your desk, letting you multitask by staying fit while you work. The treadpad boasts a running surface of 45.7L x 16W inches.
【CONNECTED FITNESS】Bluetooth connectivity via SunnyFit App keeps you in sync with your fitness goals, allowing you to track, adjust, and personalize your workouts on the go. Explore 2000+ workouts and 10,000+ workout routes from around the world.
【DIGITAL DISPLAY & REMOTE CONTROL】Monitor your Time, Speed, Calories, Steps, and Distance on the 6.3 x 2.4-inch display. Effortlessly increase and decrease speed by using the provided remote. Treadmill speed ranging from 0.5 to 6.0 MPH.
【DUAL MODE】With two modes (walk or run), this treadmill can be used without handles as a walking treadmill, with a speed range of 0.5 to 3.7 mph. With the handlebar unfolded and fully extended, the treadmill allows for running speeds of up to 6 mph.
【7% AUTO INCLINE】This hybrid walking and running treadmill boasts 6 preset incline options reaching up to 7% that automatically adjusts with just the touch of a button. Easily customize each workout to always take on the perfect level of challenge.
【QUICK ASSEMBLY】This compact treadmill arrives intact with minimal assembly required. Simply unbox, unfold the treadmill deck from the console, and begin your workout. It usually takes an average of 10 minutes to get it ready to use.
【EASY STORAGE】Foldable design for easy storage and to save space. This folding treadmill can be placed in any corner of your home or underneath furniture to maximize your living space.
【SAFETY & POWER MANAGEMENT】Designed for safety and energy management, including active-use detection to auto-pause after 5 seconds of inactivity, a safety clip, and energy conservation mode that activates after 10 minutes of no use.
【PRE-CAUTION NOTE】Place this treadmill under a desk or near a stable surface like a table, nightstand, or similar object to help users maintain balance. fields.AU:
The Trekpad Treadmill by Sunny Health & Fitness is an all-encompassing workout machine, complete with integrated trekking poles for an upper and lower body workout, and user-friendly handlebar controls for easy adjustments. Designed for the space-conscious user, it fits neatly under a desk and offers a sizeable running area, supported by smart connectivity through the SunnyFit App for extensive workout customization. With a clear LED display and remote control for simple speed changes, plus shock absorbers for joint protection, the Trekpad is both comfortable and safe to use. It arrives fully assembled with wheels for easy transportation and storage, featuring safety elements like an auto-pause function and a recommended use near a stable support to help maintain balance. Powerful yet accommodating for various fitness levels with speeds ranging from 0.5 to 3.7 mph, the Trekpad reflects Sunny Health & Fitness's commitment to quality and customer service, offering a practical solution for integrating exercise into a busy lifestyle.
• INTEGRATED TREKKING POLES- The Trekpad not only offers a full-body workout but also includes arm exercises. Control your workout intensity and speed easily with the user-friendly handlebar controls.
• COMPACT AND OFFICE-FRIENDLY- Designed for space efficiency, this slim walking treadmill easily fits under a desk. Work and walk simultaneously on its 39L x 14W inch walking area.
• CONNECTED FITNESS- Stay on top of your fitness journey with Trekpad on SunnyFit App. Bluetooth-enabled, it allows for tracking and customizing workouts, with access to over 1000 exercise programs and 10,000 global routes.
• CLEAR LED DISPLAY & REMOTE CONTROL- Keep an eye on your progress with the 6.1 x 2.4-inch LED screen, displaying time, speed, calories, steps, and distance. The remote control simplifies speed adjustments.
• LOW-IMPACT- Equipped with shock absorbers, this treadmill lessens the impact on your knees, feet, and joints, ensuring a comfortable and low-strain exercise experience.
• READY-TO-USE & PORTABLE- No assembly needed – use it straight from the box. Its built-in wheels aid in easy relocation and storage, maximizing space efficiency. The maximum recommended weight for users is 245 LB.
• ENHANCED SAFETY AND ENERGY SAVING- Prioritizing safety and energy efficiency, the treadmill features an auto-pause function after 5 seconds of inactivity, a safety clip, and an energy-saving mode that kicks in after 10 minutes of non-use.
• USE WITH CAUTION- For optimal safety, Sunny Health & Fitness advises using this treadmill with a desk or near a stable support like a table or nightstand to help maintain balance while walking or running.
• SPACIOUS & VARIABLE SPEEDS- Enjoy ample space with a running surface measuring 39L x 14W inches, accommodating a comfortable stride. Tailor your walking pace with a versatile speed range from 0.5 to 3.7 mph, powered by a 1.5 hp motor.
• Sunny Health & Fitness Commitment- A top fitness brand for 20+ years, offers superior products and a dedication to excellence. Count on our committed customer service and trainers for the best fitness experience.

fields.AU:
Experience the ultimate in-home fitness with the Sunny Health & Fitness treadmill. Featuring advanced Brushless Motor Technology, this treadmill offers a smooth, quiet running experience akin to solid ground beneath your feet. Customize your workout effortlessly with 12 automatic incline settings, ensuring every session matches your fitness level. Track your progress in real-time with the adjustable LED console displaying Calories, Distance, Pulse, Speed, and Time, while pulse sensors provide live heart rate monitoring. Connect seamlessly with the FREE SunnyFit app via Bluetooth for access to over 1,000 trainer-led videos, 10,000 virtual tours, and diverse workout programs tailored to your needs. Built for durability and safety, this treadmill supports up to 300 LB and includes features like a cushioned deck for joint protection, a convenient bottle holder, an emergency stop clip for safety, and transportation wheels for easy relocation. With over 20 years of excellence, Sunny Health & Fitness ensures top-notch equipment and unmatched support, making every workout a FIT FOR EVERYONE experience.
【AUTOMATIC INCLINE】Choose from 12 preset incline options reaching up to 13% Max Incline that adjust at the touch of a button, making it easy to customize each workout and continuously challenge yourself.
【CONNECTED FITNESS】Elevate workouts with the FREE SunnyFit app. Bluetooth sync offers 1,000+ trainer-led videos, 10,000+ tours, and diverse programs. Personalize training, track progress, and join community challenges on your treadmill.
【BRUSHLESS MOTOR TECHNOLOGY】These motors are fast and frictionless, offering a quieter treadmill running experience. Enjoy the feeling of running on solid ground from the comfort of your own home.
【CUSHIONED DECK】The 47 x 17.3” cushioned running deck reduces impact on your joints, making your workouts more comfortable and reducing the risk of injury.
【DIGITAL MONITOR & PULSE SENSORS 】Easily keep track of your progress during your workout. The large, adjustable LED console displays Calories, Distance, Pulse, Speed, and Time. Use convenient grip sensors to track your heart rate in real-time. 
【HIGH WEIGHT CAPACITY】Built to support up to 300 LB, this treadmill accommodates users of various sizes and fitness levels, providing a sturdy and reliable workout experience.
【BOTTLE HOLDER】Keep your favorite beverage within arm's length with this convenient bottle holder. No need to stop to sip, simply reach down and grab!
【EMERGENCY STOP CLIP】Safety for our customers is our primary focus. This emergency stop clip will bring the treadmill to an immediate stop when detached.
【TRANSPORTATION WHEELS】Avoid heavy lifting and muscle strain with the easy-to-use, built-in wheels. Simply tilt and roll out to place your treadmill in the desired location.
【20+ YEARS OF EXCELLENCE】As a premier brand, Sunny Health & Fitness delivers top-notch equipment dedicated to excellence. With our devoted support team and certified trainers, enjoy an unmatched FIT FOR EVERYONE experience

fields.AU:
Get ready to stay active, build up a sweat, and have fun while working out with this slim and smart-feature-capable treadmill! This treadmill is quick and easy to assemble so you will be crushing your workouts in no time. Exercising at home will be more comfortable than ever, as built-in shock absorption technology eases the amount of impact on your joints with every step you take. With 15 pre-programmed workouts and 3 fully customizable user profiles on this smart treadmill, you will have all the tools for success right at your fingertips. To experience even more variety in your workout, pair your mobile device to the treadmill via Bluetooth to access our SunnyFit® App. Here you will find a selection of treadmill courses and guided workouts led by our certified trainers to keep you on track. Hitting your cardio fitness goals has never been easier than it is with the Interactive Slim Treadmill with Bluetooth – SF-T722021!

fields.AU:
Discover the cutting-edge curved manual treadmill from Sunny Health & Fitness, a brand renowned for over 20 years in delivering superior fitness products. This treadmill revolutionizes your workout with its natural running mechanics, mirroring outdoor conditions and encouraging a more effective running form. It's engineered for enhanced calorie burning, thanks to its design that requires increased muscular effort. The treadmill also boasts a joint-friendly design with superior shock absorption, reducing impact compared to traditional treadmills. Its advanced belt, featuring an aluminum alloy core, 92 bearings, and 14 steel idlers, ensures smooth and stable movement. The adjustable sled grip handlebar caters to various workout positions, while the comprehensive LCD monitor keeps track of essential metrics like time, calories, and distance. Designed to support up to 375 pounds, it's inclusive of a wide range of users. The convenience package, including transportation wheels, a device holder, and a bottle holder, adds to its functionality. The spacious 61 x 17.7-inch non-slip belt provides ample room and secure footing, making your exercise routine both safe and effective. Backed by Sunny Health & Fitness's commitment to quality and a 3-year structural frame warranty, this treadmill is an exemplary choice for those seeking a reliable, efficient, and comfortable workout experience.

Looking to build strong glutes and a solid core without filling your home with bulky gym equipment? The Sunny Health & Fitness Multifunction Core & Glute Trainer SF-BH625020 is your all-in-one solution. Designed for the modern home gym, this 4-in-1 station safely guides you through sissy squats, hip thrusts, sit-ups, and push-ups.
For glute training, it includes a dedicated hip thrust pad plus 3 heavy-duty resistance bands, so you can add tension without barbell pressure on your hips. Adjustable base length and height-adjustable rollers help you dial in a more comfortable fit, while a reinforced steel frame and high-density padding support steady, consistent workouts in a smaller footprint.

fields.AU:
Introducing Core Fit Hex Style Dumbbells from Sunny Health & Fitness—the perfect addition to your home gym! Our dumbbells are made with high-quality materials, ensuring that they are durable and long-lasting. The hexagonal shape of the dumbbells prevents them from rolling away, making them easy and safe to use during your workout. Our hex dumbbells are perfect for a range of exercises, including strength training and toning. With a diamond knurled and an ergonomically contoured grip, you can easily hold onto the dumbbells during your workout without any discomfort. These dumbbells come in a variety of weights (from 5 to 50 lbs), making it easy to customize your workout and gradually increase your strength. Take your workout to the next level and follow along with professional trainer-led dumbbell workouts in our SunnyFit® App. Here you can track your progress, set fitness goals, and compete with other community members to get to the top of the leaderboard. Have any workout of your choice right at your fingertips, while also feeling supported and inspired as a member of this like-minded community.
• FITNESS APP EXPERIENCE: Download our app and join the SunnyFit® App community to access an array of free, professional trainer-led strength workouts and hundreds of other fitness programs. In the app, track your progress, set fitness goals, access personalized workout plans, and compete with other community members to get to the top of the leaderboard. Have any workout of your choice right at your fingertips, while also feeling supported and inspired as a member of this like-minded community.
• CHROME FINISHED HANDLE: The corrosion-resistant chrome finished handle provides a sleek look and minimizes dumbbell wear and tear.
• COMFORTABLE GRIP: The diamond knurled and ergonomic handle creates a secure grip, reducing the likelihood of the weights slipping during exercise. Avoid blisters and discomfort during your workouts with this textured and contoured grip.
• SUITABLE FOR ALL FITNESS LEVELS: With a variety of weight options to choose from (5 to 50 lbs), the Fitness Core Hex dumbbells are suitable for beginners and advanced exercisers alike. They can also be used for various exercises, from basic strength training to complex movements.
• SAFETY: The hexagonal-shaped weight plates provide stability, so your weights won’t roll when set on the ground. This is ideal for safety when not in use, but also for dumbbell exercises that require you to place your body weight over the dumbbells.
• FUNCTIONAL TRAINING: Dumbbells are a great functional training tool that allows you to add versatility to your training program. Work on improving balance and flexibility, as dumbbells require greater stabilization and allow for larger ranges of motion. Access a wide range of exercises that target multiple muscle groups to improve strength and muscle mass.
• SPACE SAVING: With compact dimensions, the dumbbells have a modest footprint, making them easily storable and designed to fit in living spaces of all sizes.
